I'm idle and waiting on the merge. The work is done and committed as `ab48dc942` on `task/restart-revive`. The revive-sweep test passes, and Servex needs a restart after the merge for the fix to apply
minion-restart-revive its agent is not running: it was stopped on purpose by mastermind-system-architect-2 at 2026-10-22T21:52:50-05:00; not revived.

findings.text: A never-started agent that has no task folder is restarted with no instructions. Servex/agents/Agents.js:437-445 reopens it fresh (`session_id: undefined`), but the registry keeps the spawn spec *minus the prompt* (Servex/agents/Registry.js:42). The only thing the agent then receives is "Start now, from the prompt you were given", and it never saw that prompt. Fix: store the first prompt on the row at spawn time and replay it here, or bury the agent with that reason when there is no task folder.

Skipping the landing check at boot (Agents.js:431, `landed: false`) applies to every agent, not only long-lived masterminds. An idle minion whose task already landed (and that nobody stopped) is now resumed at each restart and told to "answer in one line", which costs one turn per minion. The brief asks only for working and queued agents, so a narrower rule, such as `row.state === "working"` or the mastermind roles, would match it more closely.
Servex.js:1261 (`landed: !spec.resume`) widens the same exception to every held resume in the gate queue, not just the boot sweep. Neither the commit nor restart.md mentions this.

The reason is written onto the row by a second read-modify-write after `reg.bury` (Agents.js:471-475). Passing a per-id reason into `bury()` would do it in one write and keep one place that sets `ended`.

The requirements also ask why `item` went gone. The doc line (Servex/doc/restart.md:50) names only mastermind-figma-cards and mastermind-test. The diff never says which branch buried `item`, so the brief's "why each of the three" is only answered in chat, if at all.

The test (Servex/agents/revive-sweep.test.mjs) replaces `reopen` with a stub, so it checks that both rows are reopened but not that the queued row is started fresh while the working row is resumed. It could assert `r.session_id === undefined` for `queued`. Run in the worktree: "revive-sweep: 2 checks passed"; revive-skip.test.mjs still passes (6 checks).

answer.reply: fixed: d2a3f29a9. A never-started agent restarts fresh only when it has a task folder (its requirements.md is the prompt); with none it is buried, the reason on its row. Chosen over storing prompts in the registry: every spawn now gets a task dir, and prompts can be large.

declined: a landed idle agent comes back only if it was open in the last boot and active inside the window. One turn each is cheaper than losing a working mastermind, and state alone can't tell them apart (masterminds sit idle between messages). stop_agent keeps a finished minion down.
fixed: restart.md now says a held resume in the gate queue (Servex.stale) skips the landing check too, for the same reason.
noted: two writes kept; bury() has other callers, and one extra write at boot costs nothing.
fixed: restart.md names mastermind-item too (refused as landed in the 21:11 sweep, already gone at 21:30).

fixed: the test asserts the queued row starts fresh (session_id undefined), the working row resumes, and a row with no folder is buried with its reason. revive-sweep 4 checks, revive-skip 6 checks pass.
